title: IntlAiConfig
description:
One typed contract with `deny_unknown_fields` regardless of the file
format the user picked (plan section 7).

extends.description:
Consumed by the loader; kept in the struct so `config validate`
can display it.

glossary.description: Fixed term -> translation pairs injected into every translate prompt.

locale_instructions.description:
Freeform style/dialect instruction per locale. Resolution: exact
locale, then language subtag, then `*` as catch-all.

batch_size.description:
Max source entries per translate request (plan 5.3 bugfix: honored
on the initial pass too, not only refills). None = one request.

max_retries.description:
Transport attempts per request before the batch fails (default 3,
capped at 10).

processor.description:
Placeholder contract hint sent to the model. `icu` selects the ICU
MessageFormat hint; the ICU validator itself lands with W2 checks.

format.description:
Locale file format minted for new files (plan 5.5: an existing
file's own extension always wins over this preference). A builtin
name (`json`, `yaml`) or a `[[formats]]` name.

formats.description:
Custom locale format registrations (`[[formats]]`): external
programs speaking the format protocol v1 (read/write over one
JSONL request/response). Root config only, never via `extends`
(same boundary as `[[checks]] exec`).

checks.description:
Check entries (`[[checks]]`): builtins by `id`, declarative YAML
specs by `spec`, external checkers by `exec` (v1 JSONL protocol).

quality.description:
`[quality]` aggregate policy: weighted per-key score over the
configured checks with `pass`/`review`/`fail` bands. Absent =
no aggregation (checks report findings only).

file.description:
Cassette JSON: `{ "<locale>": { "<source value>": "<translation>" } }`.
Resolved against the config file's directory.

oneOf.description:
OpenAI-compatible chat-completions surface (plan 5.1.9): every surveyed
tool converges on api-url + api-key + model. `provider` selects the wire
shape; only "openai" is wired in W1.

api_key.description:
Resolved at load via `${env:VAR}`/`${file:PATH}` interpolation.
Serialized masked so `config validate` never leaks it.

base_url.description: Optional override; defaults to the provider's canonical URL.

model_params.description: Extra request-body params, spread LAST so user params win (plan 5.1.9).

oneOf.description:
Headless coding-agent CLI as a transport (the v1 differentiator: keyless
dev). Either `agent` (a preset) or `command`+optional `args`; `command`
wins when both are set (plan 5.1.6).

agent.description: Preset name from the agent table (kebab-case, see providers/presets).

command.description:
Free-form command. Allowed only in the root config file, never via
`extends` (plan 5.1.6: data files from a dependency must not spawn
arbitrary programs).

prompt_via.description:
Where the prompt travels. Default stdin; `argv` appends it as the
last arg (crush-style CLIs whose reader ignores stdin).

cwd.description:
Working directory for the spawned agent, resolved against the
config file's directory.

max_stdout_bytes.description: Buffered stdout cap before the process is killed (default 10 MiB).

cache.description:
Incremental findings cache (`.intl-ai/check-cache.json`); set
false to always re-run every check on every key (part B).

validate.description:
Shift-left validation gate (plan W2b-C): these checks run inside
`fill` between translate and adoption — failed keys get one
corrective round with the findings as reviewer notes. Only
feedback-eligible checks qualify: `icu`, `placeholder-parity`,
`judge`. Unresolved keys are adopted anyway and recorded under
`quality.unresolved` in the lockfile; `check` keeps flagging them.

FormatEntry.description:
One `[[formats]]` entry: an exec-backed custom locale format speaking
protocol v1 (one request line, one response line; see
`intl_ai_formats::exec` and docs/guide/format-plugins.md).

name.description:
Registry name selected by `format = "<name>"` (must not collide
with a builtin).

exec.description:
Exec command. Root config only, never via `extends` (same
boundary as `[[checks]] exec`).

extension.description:
Canonical extension minted for new files (`xml` mints
`locale_dir/<locale>.xml`).

extensions.description:
Extra extensions this format claims on disk (alias for
`FileFormat::for_extension`-style dispatch).

cwd.description:
Exec working directory; resolved against the config file's
directory (default: the config directory itself).

timeout_ms.description: Exec wall-clock budget per read/write op (default 60_000 ms).

max_stdout_bytes.description:
Exec buffered stdout cap (default 10 MiB — responses carry whole
files).

spec.description:
Declarative YAML check spec, resolved against the config file's
directory.

exec.description:
Exec check command (v1 JSONL protocol: one request line, one
response line). Root config only, never via `extends` (same
boundary as provider.command).

cwd.description:
Exec working directory, resolved against the config file's
directory.

threshold.description:
`judge`-only: score below this becomes an `invalid` finding
(default 0.8). Rejected on any other check kind.

QualityConfig.description:
Aggregate quality policy (`[quality]`). Each configured check
contributes a normalized 0..=1 score per key — `judge` emits real
scores, binary checks score 1.0 clean / 0.0 on a finding — weighted
by the entry's `weight`. `fail_below` produces an `invalid` finding
under check id `quality`; `review_below` marks the key `unreviewed`.

fail_below.description: Aggregate score below this is an `invalid` finding (fail band).

review_below.description:
Aggregate score below this (and at/above `fail_below`) marks the
key unreviewed (review band).
